summary.en: Attends to less familiar processes that want to appear in experience. Listed so that it can be named; not yet described.
summary.ru: Внимание к менее привычным процессам, которые стремятся проявиться в опыте. Включён, чтобы его можно было назвать; описание ещё не составлено.

mentalModel.summary: Alongside familiar ways of experiencing, less familiar processes try to appear and can be followed with attention.
assumptions: this stub records the perspective only
mentalModel.unitOfAnalysis: familiar and less familiar processes in a situation
attendsTo: signals that do not fit the familiar picture
mentalModel.languageGuidance: Offer the question only as one option, in the person's own words.
riskNotes: Experiential methods can bring up strong material; deeper work belongs with a practitioner
exploratoryQuestions: Which less familiar process wants to appear?

do: mention the perspective only when the person asks for ways of looking

helperMustNot: present itself as practising the approach
doesNotClaim: a complete description of the approach

suggestionRequires: the person asked for ways of looking at their experience

evidence.notes: Stub: listed so that the perspective can be named; not yet described or reviewed.

supports: naming the perspective the person uses
